purpose: Display-only context layer for the public district maps; not an analytical input.

method.counties: 2010 Census voting districts dissolved by county FIPS (Alabama county lines are unchanged since), simplified at 250 m
method.cities: Representative points of the named 2024 Census incorporated places (LSAD 25)
method.metro_presets: Envelope of the named city's 2024 place geometry buffered by 14,000 m; a zoom shortcut, not a metro definition
